Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You grind a pinch of frost between your fingers and fling it skyward. A curtain of whirling snow swallows the battlefield.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Target / range / shape
Connected ground squares within 6 squares, beginning at one chosen square.
Duration
Until the end of your next turn; one area at a time.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Control

Roll, then place up to the number of squares below. Every square provides heavy cover: attacks passing through or into it suffer 3 Banes. Creatures remain visible and are not automatically Hidden. The snow causes no damage and does not make difficult terrain.

Weak
Place 5 squares.
Standard
Place 8 squares.
Strong
Place 12 squares.
